newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 17.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- A planned shift to a single European currency from 1999 is expected to drive member countries to harmonise their tax policies as part of their common economic policies.
-- Central banks of France and England puzzle financial markets by leaving interest rates unchanged.
-- LVMH sells 7 percent of Guinness share capital through Goldman Sachs for five billion francs, cutting its stake in the beverage group to 14 percent.
-- Thomson-CSF executives favour market flotation for privatisation of the defence electronics group, and say they are ready to invest up to one billion francs in the firm.
